read.thesis: FY25 adjusted op margin rose to 10.7% on eProducts growth and cost control, but $624M impairments in PowerDrive and Battery & Charging flag capital misallocation; 2026 sales guided down on LV weakness and BCS decline.

capex.quote: Free cash flow increased to $1,208 million, up approximately 66% compared with 2024 due to strong operating income and capital expenditure management.

triggers.label: 2026 organic sales down 3.5% to 1.5%
triggers.quote: The Company's net sales guidance implies a year-over-year change in organic sales of down 3.5% to down 1.5%.

triggers.label: Data-centre turbine: >$300M first year
triggers.quote: Production is expected to begin in early 2027 with estimated sales of more than $300 million during the first year of production.

guidance.quote: Net sales are expected to be in the range of $14.0 billion to $14.3 billion in 2026
adjusted operating margin is expected to be in the range of 10.7% to 10.9%
adjusted net earnings are expected to be within a range of $5.00 to $5.20 per diluted share
free cash flow is expected to be in the range of $900 million to $1,100 million
Full-year operating cash flow is expected to be in the range of $1,600 million to $1,700 million

red_flags.label: $624M impairments in PowerDrive and BCS
red_flags.quote: includes $624 million of goodwill, intangible asset and property, plant and equipment impairment charges

red_flags.label: Q4 GAAP operating loss on $582M impairment
red_flags.quote: U.S. GAAP operating loss of $(238) million, or (6.7)% of net sales.
